Maya R: Quick check — I'm seeing ~3% spike in 5xx (bad gateway) for /api/v1/generate over the last 30m. Need sample traces + request_id list to triage and decide whether to relax the alert. Which dashboards/log queries do folks use? cc @Lee (oncall)

Samir: Start with Grafana > Error Rates > Route breakdown (set timeframe to 30m). Filter on /api/v1/generate. Our grafana board link: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/error-rates (go to the 'gateway' row) :mag

Devon: Datadog log query I use: `service:gateway status:502 @http.url_path:/api/v1/generate | top @request_id by count` — that returns request_id samples you can paste into Honeycomb/Traces. If you don't have request_id, use `@trace_id` instead.

Lee (oncall): Also check the LB access logs in S3 for upstream_response_time spikes: s3://redwood-prod-logs/lb/gateway/YYYY/MM/DD — often 502s correlate with high upstream_response_time or 429s from the upstream.

Maya R: Nice. Can someone drop a honeycomb trace query snippet? Want 3-5 full traces to attach to the ticket.

Samir: Honeycomb query to sample a few traces:
```
trace.dataset("prod-gateway")
  .filter("http.status_code == 502 && http.path == '/api/v1/generate'")
  .group_by("trace.trace_id")
  .sample(5)
```
That gives a handful of representative traces.

Devon: If you're after spans for flamegraphs, send me 3 trace ids and I can produce full flamegraphs. Also check backend pod logs (`kubectl -n prod logs deploy/upstream-service --since=30m | grep "request_id=")`.

Maya R: For the alert itself — it's firing a lot of noise right now. Any quick tuning suggestions?

Devon: If it's flappy, change the alert to something like: `count(502) by route > 10 in 5m AND unique(request_id) > 5` — that ignores bursty single-request errors and retries. Add a 10m debounce before re-alerting.

Lee (oncall): Agreed. Also consider switching to a rate-of-errors SLO violation (p50 5xx rate) instead of raw count for noisy endpoints. I'll add both options to the runbook. Runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/gateway-5xx

Maya R: Can someone add the grafana/datadog/honeycomb snippets to the runbook so oncall can pull them quickly next time?

Lee (oncall): I'll update the runbook now with the queries and a sample reproduce curl. Will also suppress the noisy alert for 12m while we triage.

Devon: Sample reproduce header (for QA):
```bash
curl -H "X-Request-Id: demo-123" -i https://gateway.redwood.ai/api/v1/generate
```
Use that to track through logs/traces.

alerts-bot: Alert 5xx-gateway-prod suppressed by @Lee (oncall) for 12m :white_check_mark:

Maya R: Thanks — grabbing traces now. If I find a clear upstream host or pattern I'll post trace ids here.

Devon: If you paste 3 trace ids I can pull flamegraphs and post an immediate hypothesis. :rocket:
